classification: Prescribed virtual gas and radiation reservoirs; equilibrium reaction limit with physically separate inner/outer ledgers
boundary_change_interpretation: Switch contacts to distinct prescribed reservoirs at 4000s; no instantaneous change of cell inventory or internal energy. No model of the energy required to condition the external reservoirs.
scope: One-dimensional conditional equilibrium reaction and shared gas/energy transport. No actual brick material accuracy or finite-rate chemistry.

domain.geometry_classification: Virtual 2cm fixed-volume planar column, sealed left and one open right surface.

transport.classification: declared virtual positive symmetric gas exchange, not calibrated Darcy or binary diffusivity
transport.source_note: No material measurement; Onsager supplies near-equilibrium response structure only; finite force use is an explicit constitutive extension.

surface_geometry: Surface area equals domain area; interior surface distance is half the cell width; internal faces use full cell width. Interior density coefficients are taken from transport; external film/radiation from the explicit surface file.
